As a cancer survivor of 18 years, I know how devastating and life-altering a diagnosis can be. 

On #WorldCancerDay, my heart is with the fighters, survivors, and all families who have lost loved ones to this heartbreaking disease. I pray for the day we find a cure. https://t.co/0Wt24FBMKH

In a win for America's veterans, U.S. Park Police escort services for Honor Flight trips will resume June 1. Our veterans deserve the red-carpet treatment as they visit Washington's historic monuments. Big thanks to @RepChipRoy for leading the charge! https://t.co/uv4yIvbouL

During #NationalCancerSurvivorMonth, we honor the 16.9 million survivors in the U.S. & celebrate life-saving innovations in prevention, detection, and treatment.

As a survivor myself, I know how life-altering this disease can be. Together, we can raise awareness and find a cure.

Telehealth is essential - especially for our rural communities. 

I'm a proud co-sponsor of the Expanded Telehealth Access Act to remove barriers for patients and providers while delivering accessible, timely, and reliable telehealth services to Utahns. https://t.co/2Ysc8u3xDj

This morning, my team and I toured Intuitech, a leading provider of water treatment pilot plants in #UT04. We enjoyed seeing this cutting-edge technology in action and learning more about how they help provide safe drinking water across Utah and the country. https://t.co/gwQaPHntrB

President Biden’s EO redirecting $3.5 billion from the USVSST uses preferential treatment to compensate American victims of terror & prioritizes lawyers. Proud to support the Justice for American Victims of Terror Act of 2022 to right these wrongs. https://t.co/RNWPnSfqEu

Utah is leading the way in advanced research & cutting-edge technology to treat the world’s most debilitating illnesses. Enjoyed visiting @UUtah’s Neuroscience Center to discuss how this state-wide healthcare system is innovating to more effectively diagnose & care for patients. https://t.co/nd5NITZrgC

September is #NationalSickleCellDiseaseMonth. Proud to join the Congressional Sickle Cell Caucus to raise awareness of this life-altering disease and highlight our shared goals to increase support for patients, improve health outcomes, and develop a cure. https://t.co/MXxBYwDo7o

As a survivor, I know how devastating and life-altering cancer can be for a patient and their loved ones. Thank you to @ACSCAN for sharing their ongoing efforts to raise awareness of early detection and diagnosis & the cutting-edge developments in life-saving treatments. https://t.co/Ay8KUf1NrD

Proud to co-sponsor the Huntington's Disease Disability Insurance Act to help Americans fight this devastating diagnosis by waiving the 5-month waiting period for social security benefits & eliminating the 24-month waiting period for Medicare coverage. 
https://t.co/2S01PRMmZI

Telehealth services are an essential, life-saving tool for Americans in #UT04 and across the nation. I'm proud to support the Expanded Telehealth Access Act to help increase accessibility, affordability, and flexibility for millions of patients.

https://t.co/hik4rTJ7za https://t.co/d19UgjhvP3

I'm joining today's @EdWorkforceCmte markup to consider four bills that will promote transparency in the healthcare billing process and lower drug costs for patients across America. 

Tune in: 
https://t.co/tiPZV1jYgT

The Jordan Valley Water Treatment Plant, Utah's largest conventional water plant, is on a mission to deliver 255 million gallons of clean water daily. I toured this state-of-the-art facility yesterday for an update on operation expansions and efforts to meet current water needs. https://t.co/QfL5y2X7ad

The Discovery Ranch Residential Treatment Center in Mapleton, UT has an unwavering commitment to shaping our youth's academic and personal growth and building confidence in their futures. Thanks for having us and for all you do to show the next generation what's possible. https://t.co/QKzBiaDLE9

Granger-Hunter Improvement District is committed to providing safe & clean drinking water for our community. 

It was a great opportunity to tour their new Rushton Groundwater Treatment Plant & see how their remarkable team is continuing to improve on their services to #UT04. https://t.co/J9l5cig4yX

I voted in favor of the Protecting Health Care for All Patients Act to expand access to health care by preventing discrimination against Americans with disabilities. All Americans, regardless of their health status or disabilities, deserve equal access to the care they need.

The MVP Act has my support because it expands patient access to high-cost, life-saving drugs while ensuring that treatment costs are linked to patient outcomes. This is a significant step in prioritizing effectiveness and accessibility to innovative treatments and cures. https://t.co/23gXS93X24
The DEI scam claims that doctors' skin color should matter more than the quality of care patients receive. This is un-American and wrong. https://t.co/kgLuNODCky

Illegal immigrants shouldn't get special treatment at our airports. I teamed up with @RepMarkGreen to introduce legislation ensuring TSA doesn't accept unverified IDs — like the CBP One Mobile App — to protect our borders and keep Americans safe. https://t.co/I3sUScXJfJ

The new Miller Campus at Lehi Primary Children's Hospital will help thousands of young patients in Utah County and beyond access high-quality care. I was so glad to join Lehi Mayor Mark Johnson and hospital staff for a tour last week. https://t.co/aqo3J3jjmg

I was glad to meet with Steve Verhaaren and Rick Lybbert of Mountainland Partners Physical Therapy this morning. Their dedication to providing top-notch care while navigating challenging healthcare and insurance issues is making a real difference in our community. https://t.co/DCo5rSJJ4j

Proud to vote YES on this year's MilConVA Appropriations package. @HouseGOP is funding veterans' healthcare, building more housing for military families, and investing in our military's preparedness to prioritize America’s strength, safety, and security.

Utah's water utilities are investing millions into treatment and disposal of dangerous PFAS chemicals. I'm proud to back @RepJohnCurtis' bill to ensure that industrial polluters take similar steps instead of passing on their cleanup liabilities onto ratepayers. https://t.co/ujgbnUJnaT

Utah innovators like @ARUPLabs are changing the world through innovative healthcare solutions. Thank you to @WaysandMeansGOP for holding this important hearing to see how we can learn from the Utah model to incentivize medical innovation across the nation. https://t.co/IofVnaPvnO

Had a great visit at @Intermountain Riverton Hospital! Their state-of-the-art cancer treatment center, emergency room, and imaging services are impressive. Grateful for the wonderful staff and such an outstanding facility serving Utah's 4th District! https://t.co/CDAWHSA79R
